item.description:
# Draftava 1.3.2
- Moves routine debounced persistence work off the main actor so autosaves do less work on the UI thread. - Adds Back and Forward draft navigation in the toolbar, following actual draft visit history. - Improves editor drag auto-scroll with smoother 60 Hz velocity-based scrolling near the top and bottom edges. - Adds edge auto-scroll while reordering cards in the right-side Idea Shelf. - Fixes converted Markdown paste undo so one Undo removes the whole pasted conversion. - Renames the right-side per-draft idea rail to Idea Shelf.
